auth.description: Free endpoint requires existing server authentication, issued actor and owner. The client pins the initiating account through every chunk and publication.

credentials.description: Approved new 90-day account-only Workers AI Read token in one Google secret, accessible only to existing runtime identity. No customer custody change.

egress.description: Approved user-initiated PCM through authenticated API to fixed Cloudflare Whisper endpoint. No draft/project data, raw-audio storage, paid fallback or arbitrary destination. Explicit local mode keeps prior on-device behavior.

cost.description: Workers Free only. Existing canonical holds and zero-cost settlement/usage verification remain mandatory. Google one-time <=$0.10 and incremental <=$5/month within approved allocation, credits first. No paid speech overage.

architecture.reason: The existing composer remains the single draft and Send owner. A disposable inference worker handles speech only, with no agent or task execution authority.

rollback: Restore retained local-only voice frontend before restoring previous compatible paired API/Job digest 49505ef9. Keep KMS, data, platform secret and current feature holds. No production SQL.
